verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، إِنْ قَبِلْتَ كَلَامِي وَخَبَّأْتَ وَصَايَايَ عِنْدَكَ،
verses.kjv: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.web: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
verses.he: בְּ֭נִי אִם־תִּקַּ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֹתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: حَتَّى تُمِيلَ أُذْنَكَ إِلَى ٱلْحِكْمَةِ، وَتُعَطِّفَ قَلْبَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفَهْمِ،
verses.kjv: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, [and] apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.web: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
verses.he: לְהַקְשִׁ֣יב לַֽחָכְמָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑ךָ תַּטֶּ֥ה לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַתְּבוּנָֽה׃

verses.ar: إِنْ دَعَوْتَ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةَ، وَرَفَعْتَ صَوْتَكَ إِلَى ٱلْفَهْمِ،
verses.kjv: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, [and] liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.web: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
verses.he: כִּ֤י אִ֣ם לַבִּינָ֣ה תִקְרָ֑א לַ֝תְּבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קֹולֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: إِنْ طَلَبْتَهَا كَٱلْفِضَّةِ، وَبَحَثْتَ عَنْهَا كَٱلْكُنُوزِ،
verses.kjv: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as [for] hid treasures;
verses.web: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;
verses.he: אִם־תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמֹונִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃

verses.ar: فَحِينَئِذٍ تَفْهَمُ مَخَافَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَتَجِدُ مَعْرِفَةَ ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.web: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.he: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يُعْطِي حِكْمَةً. مِنْ فَمِهِ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةُ وَٱلْفَهْمُ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth [cometh] knowledge and understanding.
verses.web: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
verses.he: כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃

verses.ar: يَذْخَرُ مَعُونَةً لِلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ. هُوَ مِجَنٌّ لِلسَّالِكِينَ بِٱلْكَمَالِ،
verses.kjv: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: [he is] a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.web: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
verses.he: *וְצָפַן (יִצְפֹּ֣ן) לַ֭יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְהֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם׃

verses.ar: لِنَصْرِ مَسَالِكِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَحِفْظِ طَرِيقِ أَتْقِيَائِهِ.
verses.kjv: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.web: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
verses.he: לִ֭נְצֹר אָרְחֹ֣ות מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְדֶ֖רֶךְ *חֲסִידֹו (חֲסִידָ֣יו) יִשְׁמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ تَفْهَمُ ٱلْعَدْلَ وَٱلْحَقَّ وَٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةَ، كُلَّ سَبِيلٍ صَالِحٍ.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; [yea], every good path.
verses.web: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
verses.he: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כָּל־מַעְגַּל־טֹֽוב׃

verses.ar: إِذَا دَخَلَتِ ٱلْحِكْمَةُ قَلْبَكَ، وَلَذَّتِ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةُ لِنَفْسِكَ،
verses.kjv: ¶ When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.web: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.he: כִּֽי־תָבֹ֣וא חָכְמָ֣ה בְלִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝דַ֗עַת לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ֥ יִנְעָֽם׃

verses.ar: فَٱلْعَقْلُ يَحْفَظُكَ، وَٱلْفَهْمُ يَنْصُرُكَ،
verses.kjv: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.web: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
verses.he: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה׃

verses.ar: لِإِنْقَاذِكَ مِنْ طَرِيقِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ، وَمِنَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّمِ بِٱلْأَكَاذِيبِ،
verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the way of the evil [man], from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.web: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
verses.he: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֹֽות׃

verses.ar: ٱلتَّارِكِينَ سُبُلَ ٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ لِلسُّلُوكِ فِي مَسَالِكِ ٱلظُّلْمَةِ،
verses.kjv: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.web: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
verses.he: הַ֭עֹ֣זְבִים אָרְחֹ֣ות יֹ֑שֶׁר לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת בְּדַרְכֵי־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

verses.ar: ٱلْفَرِحِينَ بِفَعْلِ ٱلسُّوءِ، ٱلْمُبْتَهِجِينَ بِأَكَاذِيبِ ٱلشَّرِّ،
verses.kjv: Who rejoice to do evil, [and] delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.web: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
verses.he: הַ֭שְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשֹׂ֥ות רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכֹ֥ות רָֽע׃

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ طُرُقُهُمْ مُعْوَجَّةٌ، وَهُمْ مُلْتَوُونَ فِي سُبُلِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Whose ways [are] crooked, and [they] froward in their paths:
verses.web: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם עִקְּשִׁ֑ים וּ֝נְלֹוזִ֗ים בְּמַעְגְּלֹותָֽם׃

verses.ar: لِإِنْقَاذِكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ ٱلْأَجْنَبِيَّةِ، مِنَ ٱلْغَرِيبَةِ ٱلْمُتَمَلِّقَةِ بِكَلَامِهَا،
verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the strange woman, [even] from the stranger [which] flattereth with her words;
verses.web: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
verses.he: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃

verses.ar: ٱلتَّارِكَةِ أَلِيفَ صِبَاهَا، وَٱلنَّاسِيَةِ عَهْدَ إِلَهِهَا.
verses.kjv: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.web: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
verses.he: הַ֭עֹזֶבֶת אַלּ֣וּף נְעוּרֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־בְּרִ֖ית אֱלֹהֶ֣יהָ שָׁכֵֽחָה׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ بَيْتَهَا يَسُوخُ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ، وَسُبُلُهَا إِلَى ٱلْأَخِيلَةِ.
verses.kjv: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.web: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
verses.he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה אֶל־מָ֣וֶת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְאֶל־רְ֝פָאִ֗ים מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ مَنْ دَخَلَ إِلَيْهَا لَا يَؤُوبُ، وَلَا يَبْلُغُونَ سُبُلَ ٱلْحَيَاةِ.
verses.kjv: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.web: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
verses.he: כָּל־בָּ֭אֶיהָ לֹ֣א יְשׁוּב֑וּן וְלֹֽא־יַ֝שִּׂ֗יגוּ אָרְחֹ֥ות חַיִּֽים׃

verses.ar: حَتَّى تَسْلُكَ فِي طَرِيقِ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ وَتَحْفَظَ سُبُلَ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ.
verses.kjv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good [men], and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.web: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.he: לְמַ֗עַן תֵּ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טֹובִ֑ים וְאָרְחֹ֖ות צַדִּיקִ֣ים תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ يَسْكُنُونَ ٱلْأَرْضَ، وَٱلْكَامِلِينَ يَبْقَوْنَ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.web: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
verses.he: כִּֽי־יְשָׁרִ֥ים יִשְׁכְּנוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִוָּ֥תְרוּ בָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلْأَشْرَارُ فَيَنْقَرِضُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَٱلْغَادِرُونَ يُسْتَأْصَلُونَ مِنْهَا.
verses.kjv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.web: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
verses.he: וּ֭רְשָׁעִים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ וּ֝בֹוגְדִ֗ים יִסְּח֥וּ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃ פ
